<p dir="auto">For async methods, <code>CompletableFuture</code> wraps thrown errors in <code>CompletionException</code>
(JDK behaviour). Use <code>Helpers.unwrap()</code> inside <code>.exceptionally(...)</code> to peel the wrap
and pattern-match the real cause:</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-java notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto"><pre><span class="pl-k">import</span> <span class="pl-s1">io</span>.<span class="pl-s1">github</span>.<span class="pl-s1">ccxt</span>.<span class="pl-s1">Helpers</span>;

<span class="pl-s1">binance</span>.<span class="pl-en">createOrderAsync</span>(<span class="pl-s">"BTC/USDT"</span>, <span class="pl-s">"limit"</span>, <span class="pl-s">"buy"</span>, <span class="pl-c1">0.001</span>, <span class="pl-c1">50000.0</span>)
    .<span class="pl-en">thenAccept</span>(<span class="pl-s1">order</span> -> <span class="pl-s1">log</span>.<span class="pl-en">info</span>(<span class="pl-s">"placed "</span> + <span class="pl-s1">order</span>.<span class="pl-s1">id</span>))
    .<span class="pl-en">exceptionally</span>(<span class="pl-s1">throwable</span> -> {
        <span class="pl-smi">Throwable</span> <span class="pl-s1">cause</span> = <span class="pl-smi">Helpers</span>.<span class="pl-en">unwrap</span>(<span class="pl-s1">throwable</span>);
        <span class="pl-k">return</span> <span class="pl-k">switch</span> (<span class="pl-s1">cause</span>) {
            <span class="pl-k">case</span> <span class="pl-smi">InsufficientFunds</span>    <span class="pl-s1">e</span> -> { <span class="pl-en">notifyUser</span>(<span class="pl-s1">e</span>); yield <span class="pl-c1">null</span>; }
            <span class="pl-k">case</span> <span class="pl-smi">AuthenticationError</span>  <span class="pl-s1">e</span> -> { <span class="pl-en">refreshCreds</span>(); yield <span class="pl-c1">null</span>; }
            <span class="pl-k">case</span> <span class="pl-smi">RateLimitExceeded</span>    <span class="pl-s1">e</span> -> { <span class="pl-en">scheduleRetry</span>(); yield <span class="pl-c1">null</span>; }
            <span class="pl-k">case</span> <span class="pl-smi">NetworkError</span>         <span class="pl-s1">e</span> -> { <span class="pl-en">scheduleRetry</span>(); yield <span class="pl-c1">null</span>; }
            <span class="pl-k">case</span> <span class="pl-smi">BaseError</span>            <span class="pl-s1">e</span> -> { <span class="pl-s1">log</span>.<span class="pl-en">error</span>(<span class="pl-s">"ccxt"</span>, <span class="pl-s1">e</span>); yield <span class="pl-c1">null</span>; }
            <span class="pl-k">default</span> -> <span class="pl-k">throw</span> <span class="pl-k">new</span> <span class="pl-smi">java</span>.<span class="pl-smi">util</span>.<span class="pl-smi">concurrent</span>.<span class="pl-smi">CompletionException</span>(<span class="pl-s1">cause</span>);
        };
    });</pre><div class="zeroclipboard-container">
    <clipboard-copy aria-label="Copy code to clipboard" class="ClipboardButton btn btn-invisible js-clipboard-copy m-2 p-0 d-flex flex-justify-center flex-items-center" data-copy-feedback="Copied!" data-tooltip-direction="w" value="import io.github.ccxt.Helpers;

binance.createOrderAsync("BTC/USDT", "limit", "buy", 0.001, 50000.0)
    .thenAccept(order -> log.info("placed " + order.id))
    .exceptionally(throwable -> {
        Throwable cause = Helpers.unwrap(throwable);
        return switch (cause) {
            case InsufficientFunds    e -> { notifyUser(e); yield null; }
            case AuthenticationError  e -> { refreshCreds(); yield null; }
            case RateLimitExceeded    e -> { scheduleRetry(); yield null; }
            case NetworkError         e -> { scheduleRetry(); yield null; }
            case BaseError            e -> { log.error("ccxt", e); yield null; }
            default -> throw new java.util.concurrent.CompletionException(cause);
        };
    });" tabindex="0" role="button">

<p dir="auto">WebSocket support is available via the pro exchange classes:</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-java notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto"><pre><span class="pl-k">import</span> <span class="pl-s1">io</span>.<span class="pl-s1">github</span>.<span class="pl-s1">ccxt</span>.<span class="pl-s1">Exchange</span>;
<span class="pl-k">import</span> <span class="pl-s1">io</span>.<span class="pl-s1">github</span>.<span class="pl-s1">ccxt</span>.<span class="pl-s1">exchanges</span>.<span class="pl-s1">pro</span>.<span class="pl-s1">Binance</span>;

<span class="pl-k">import</span> <span class="pl-s1">java</span>.<span class="pl-s1">util</span>.<span class="pl-s1">concurrent</span>.<span class="pl-s1">TimeUnit</span>;

<span class="pl-smi">Exchange</span> <span class="pl-s1">exchange</span> = <span class="pl-k">new</span> <span class="pl-smi">Binance</span>();
<span class="pl-s1">exchange</span>.<span class="pl-en">loadMarkets</span>().<span class="pl-en">join</span>();

<span class="pl-c">// stream live ticker updates</span>
<span class="pl-k">for</span> (<span class="pl-smi">int</span> <span class="pl-s1">i</span> = <span class="pl-c1">0</span>; <span class="pl-s1">i</span> < <span class="pl-c1">10</span>; <span class="pl-s1">i</span>++) {
    <span class="pl-smi">Object</span> <span class="pl-s1">ticker</span> = <span class="pl-s1">exchange</span>.<span class="pl-en">watchTicker</span>(<span class="pl-s">"BTC/USDT"</span>).<span class="pl-en">get</span>(<span class="pl-c1">30</span>, <span class="pl-smi">TimeUnit</span>.<span class="pl-c1">SECONDS</span>);
    <span class="pl-smi">System</span>.<span class="pl-s1">out</span>.<span class="pl-en">println</span>(<span class="pl-s1">ticker</span>);
}</pre><div class="zeroclipboard-container">

<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Rate limiting</h2><a id="user-content-rate-limiting" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Rate limiting" href="#rate-limiting"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">Crypto exchanges enforce rate limits to protect their infrastructure, ensure fair usage across all clients, and prevent abuse that could degrade performance or availability for other users. That means you can't make an unlimited amount of requests to the exchange, there is a rate that needs to be respected.</p>
<p dir="auto">By default, CCXT uses a <strong>leaky bucket</strong> rate limiter to control the pace of outgoing requests. A leaky bucket rate limiter works by queueing requests and releasing them at a steady, fixed rate. Bursts of requests are smoothed out over time rather than executed immediately.</p>
<p dir="auto">However, if the user provides a <code>rateLimiterAlgorithm': 'rollingWindow'</code> option, ccxt switches from the leaky bucket model to a <strong>window-based rate</strong> limiter. A window-based limiter enforces a maximum number of requests within a fixed time window (for example, N requests per X milliseconds). Once the limit is reached, further requests are delayed until the current window expires. By default CCXT assumes a 60s window but the window size can be customized by providing <code>rollingWindowSize: X0000</code> ms.</p>
<p dir="auto">Example:</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-python notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto"><pre><span class="pl-s1">exchange</span> <span class="pl-c1">=</span> <span class="pl-s1">ccxt</span>.<span class="pl-c1">binance</span>({
    <span class="pl-s">'rateLimiterAlgorithm'</span>: <span class="pl-s">'rollingWindow'</span>, <span class="pl-c"># switching to rolling window algorithm</span>
    <span class="pl-s">'rollingWindowSize'</span>: <span class="pl-c1">5000</span> <span class="pl-c"># if binance allows X requests per 5 seconds, those requests can be fired in a burst at any time during this window</span>
})</pre><div class="zeroclipboard-container">

    'rateLimiterAlgorithm': 'rollingWindow', # switching to rolling window algorithm
    'rollingWindowSize': 5000 # if binance allows X requests per 5 seconds, those requests can be fired in a burst at any time during this window
})" tabindex="0" role="button">

<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">CCXT CLI</h2><a id="user-content-ccxt-cli" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: CCXT CLI" href="#ccxt-cli"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">Read the documentation for more information and details: <a href="https://github.com/ccxt/ccxt/tree/master/cli/README.md">docs</a></p>
<p dir="auto">CCXT also provides a command-line interface (CLI) that enables direct interaction with any supported exchange from the terminal. You can quickly check balances, place orders, or fetch trade data - all of that without the need to write or execute custom code and without the overhead of building an entire application from scratch. This is especially useful for simple or time-sensitive tasks (shell scripting, testing and debugging among other things).</p>

<p dir="auto">CCXT is not a service nor a server. CCXT is a software. <strong>CCXT is a free open source non-custodian API broker software under MIT license</strong>.</p>
<ul dir="auto">
<li><strong>Non-custodian</strong> means CCXT is not an intermediary in trading, it does not hold traders' money at any point in time, traders install CCXT and use CCXT to talk to exchanges directly.</li>
<li><strong>MIT license</strong> means CCXT can be used for any purpose, but use at your own risk without any warranties.</li>
<li><strong>API broker</strong> means CCXT is funded with rebates from exchanges' API broker programs and it is an official API broker with many exchanges, all rebates and related fees are handled by the exchanges solely in accordance with exchanges' respective terms and conditions established by each partner exchange.</li>
<li><strong>Free software</strong> means CCXT is free to use and has no hidden fees, with CCXT traders pay the same trading fees they would pay to the exchanges directly.</li>
<li><strong>Open source</strong> means anyone is allowed to use it, to look inside the code and to change everything, including other brokers.</li>
</ul>
